reviews.text: One of the funnest phone games of the past decade in a permanent archival form that requires no internet. Definitely recommend.

edit: tutorial still unskippable but bug fixed, intro now skippable (buggy though), everything else is the same lazy ♥♥♥♥. less than zero-effort mobile port, as usual. half the content removed (iap too, the only positive), so it's essentially a demo and not compatible with the mobile version. only has the phone-sized vertical gameplay window, taking up a fraction of the screen, both lazy and ugly, just look at the screenshots on the store page. [b]no full screen mode(!!!), no volume settings, only music and sfx on/off[/b]. the really loud intro was made unskippable (buggy though, doesn't stop immediately and there's some gumball dialog to click through in the meantime), and after accidentally closing the game during the tutorial (♥♥♥♥ me for wanting to check what little settings there are), I had to re-watch and re-do the whole thing. or would've had to, except from then on I [b]couldn't get past the very first tutorial prompt[/b]. tried again because no profiles or reset progress in-game, just a start button. then had to delete the save manually, watch the ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ intro for the FOURTH ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ time and it still didn't work, so I gave up. the 0.0.3 version number is no joke. how they managed to ♥♥♥♥ up a decade-old (or more, can't be bothered to check) game this much is beyond me, but not beyond them. besides a couple of languages the only setting (and only available while playing, not from the main menu) is a [b]press and hold toggle that doesn't work[/b]. I was surprised they didn't leave tapping in for the description, but [b]whether it's on or off, you need to hold left click to bring up enemy info in a new window, covering the entire game area[/b] (can't say screen, as it runs in a tiny window) because click means attack and [b]there is no right click or mouseover functionality in this sorry excuse for a pc game[/b]. then there's the always annoying typewriter effect for all the dialog, of which there's a lot, with an added sound effect for every single speech bubble. what exactly was the point of this release? playing the mobile version on an emulator will give you a better pc experience and more functionality. would've been cool to have it properly ported but this is insulting. at least they had the decency not to ask money for it, but ♥♥♥♥ for free is still just ♥♥♥♥. and the excessive tag abuse on the store page is the cherry on top. is it a roguelike, traditional roguelike or roguelite? rpg, strategy, strategy rpg or turn-based strategy? all of the above, apparently, and much more, 'drama' being the biggest draw of all. ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ hell. oh, and it doesn't work on win7 even though the store page says so.

in short, a mobile port released on steam is the only downside. in ...er....long? my initial reaction was oh ffs. a mobile port not made for steam market but pisspoor ported anyway. then within 10 minutes i am like WTF!!! not a single popup trying to sell me stuff of zero value at mega price? what madness is this?? what makes this worthy of the double question mark is that the game is really good!!! what makes THAT more than worthy of the triple...yes triple exclamation mark is the fact that not only is it good but has shown me no way to GIVE the developer money. i know right? shut the front door. what kind of developer creates a pretty good mobile game, does NOT include sales popups every 30 maddening seconds and even makes the game free?! *insert explosive mind-blown sound effects here* of course i have only played a little and sure i suspect there will be some kind of purchase system in place further in, but how many games lack a sales pitch over 2 hours in? bloody devs are letting the side down. they wouldn't even qualify for a job at bethesda or any other so called top studio for lack of game breaking bugs!! it's so preposterous it has even initialised my sarcasm!!!! definitely worth a play and devs are totally getting an applause from me, which i can't prove as i broke my webcam in all the confusion so ya just gonna have to imagine it devs. wobbly body parts and all...

Just like the mobile version, only with about half the content. All* references to Sky and Space have been removed or reworked into bland bonuses, most Sky dungeons and events have been turned into land events with tons of rewards removed, Statues are apparently gone (goodbye Little May), and baby gumballs are nowhere to be found. *Some Sky rewards were missed in the removal pass and cause weirdness. For example, a God of Thieves robot in Bracada College can be found and searched for a reward of three unknown material and 999 Brave Amulets. To be honest, if this is what we got, I would have preferred if the IAPs were left in (as a veteran player, they were honestly reasonable considering the amount of free premium currency the game had) and we got everything as it was only with the terrible Chaos PvP system removed.

看到评论区人均100小时+就知道这游戏的含金量了。要是能出手游就好了。 《不思议迷宫》以 Roguelike 的随机探索为骨，以冈布奥组合的策略创意为魂，将 “随机性” 与 “确定性” 玩出了令人着迷的深度。这款游戏最精妙的魅力，在于上百只冈布奥间千变万化的搭配艺术 —— 看似不起眼的三只小家伙，一旦形成默契联动，便能在迷宫中掀起颠覆战局的风暴，每一组搭配都是一次充满惊喜的策略探险。 暴力美学的极致演绎当属 “撒雕王” 组合（撒旦之子 + 骷髅王 + 雕刻家）。撒旦之子能将所有卷轴转化为暗系魔法并强化 50% 伤害，让 “死亡波纹” 这类 AOE 技能成为清场利器；骷髅王的斯克强吸能术完美解决续航难题，100 层以下只需一发便能满血回蓝；而雕刻家打造的 “沉思者” 雕像叠满后，可提供 75 点魔力与 75% 伤害加成，配合暗系大师称号，能将伤害增幅拉至 120% 以上。当暗系魔法的毁灭性与无间断续航结合，爬高 100 层竟成了 “按部就班的享受”，这种暴力与精密的平衡，正是搭配乐趣的核心。 召唤流的狂欢则由 “白学组合”（冒险者 + 小美 + 雅典娜）书写。雅典娜能将迷宫村民转化为继承自身属性的斗士，冒险者进一步提升村民出现概率，小美则通过翻地板累积属性加成 —— 三者联动下，召唤物从 “临时帮手” 蜕变为 “主力军团”。更妙的是组合背后的剧情梗，冒险者与雅典娜的暧昧、小美作为青梅竹马的加入，让每一次召唤都多了层趣味联想，策略性与故事感在此刻完美交融。 速刷爱好者的福音当属 “冒险者 + 海贼王 + 雅典娜” 的黄金三角。海贼王每层大概率产出宝藏，冒险者触发村民事件，双重资源加持让称号升级快如闪电；雅典娜召唤的双斗士则承包了所有战斗，玩家只需专注翻地板、捡道具，70 层以下堪称 “躺赢”。而 “强盗 + 怪盗 + 考古家” 则是收集控的最爱，怪盗银之手盗物品、强盗飞爪偷龙珠、考古家强化神器属性，迷宫里的每一寸资源都逃不过掌心，那种 “清空地图” 的满足感无与伦比。 高难度挑战的王牌则是 “佐罗 + 虫族女王 + 斯巴达” 的万金油组合。斯巴达加速技能能量回复，佐罗 Z 字斩实现 AOE 清场，虫族女王的虫卵自爆堪称 BOSS 杀手。在古代竞技场中，这套组合搭配龙鳞套后，既能靠 AOE 横扫普通层，又能凭爆发秒掉高血量 BOSS，从前期过渡到后期爬高全程无短板，被玩家奉为 “竞技场之王”。 这些组合并非一成不变的公式。配合不同迷宫特性调整称号（如魔法系点 “黑暗祭祀” 强化暗伤，冒险系点 “大盗神” 探隐藏）、搭配药水与神器（狼人药剂强化召唤物、竖琴加速探索），同一组合能玩出截然不同的效果。更令人着迷的是，游戏还藏着无数 “隐藏联动”—— 比如神灯的魔毯回退 30 层刷资源、国王的征税技能辅助养 “狗”（二郎神召唤物），每一次新发现都像解开彩蛋般惊喜。 《不思议迷宫》的创意精髓，在于它让组合搭配成为一种 “可探索的乐趣”。无论是追求暴力输出、资源收集，还是速刷通关，都能找到专属的策略路径。当你终于凑齐心仪组合，看着技能联动产生 1+1+1>3 的奇效时，那种 “掌控迷宫” 的成就感，正是这款游戏最动人的魔力。

虽然游戏本体是个模仿Dungelot的氪金手游，但《不思议迷官》是少有的青出于蓝而胜于蓝的国产模仿者，光是分支众多的升级路线，以及借鉴《英雄无敌》的法术系统，就足以组合出相当丰富的单局体验，更不用说长达十年的运营加入的数百个英雄角色，让本作的可玩性远远甩开它的前辈。只可惜PC版的《不思议迷宫》仅仅是个简单移植，界面布局和操作方式完全没做调整（另一边的Dungelot也是同样的吃相），导致PC端用鼠标翻格远不如触屏点击来得方便，对于回坑的玩家其实还是手机版玩着更舒服。
